description: This file defines the LockSnapshot class, which models an instance of a held lock (monitor object) in a thread, including its properties and methods for cloning, comparing, and equality checks.

classes.name: LockSnapshot
classes.description: Represents an instance of a held lock (java monitor object) in a thread, with properties such as type, address, packageName, className, and threadId, and methods for cloning, equality, hashing, and comparison.

methods.name: LockSnapshot
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty LockSnapshot instance.

methods.name: LockSnapshot
methods.description: Copy constructor for creating a new LockSnapshot based on another instance.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of the current LockSnapshot.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks whether this LockSnapshot is equal to another based on the address.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the address property.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this LockSnapshot to another based on the address for ordering.
